# Marc Borer

> Senior ICT Systems Architect in Breitenbach, Switzerland: hybrid identity, Microsoft 365, endpoint lifecycle and, with Attestree, attested software delivery for Windows fleets. Site in German (default) and English (/en/).

## Who

Marc Borer designs and runs business-critical Microsoft infrastructure (hybrid identity, Exchange Online and Teams, Intune and endpoint lifecycle, SIEM) and has been responsible since 2019 for the target architecture of an international industrial company's cloud and hybrid infrastructure. Since 2026 he has been building Attestree (https://attestree.com), an independent research and open-core project: an app-patching control plane that attests software for Windows fleets before rollout: sandbox detonation, an observed SBOM and a signed in-toto statement per winget, Chocolatey or Scoop version, then ring-based delivery (canary, pilot, broad, all) pinned to the attested bytes.
